system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: GISSI-HF NCT00336336 - GISSI-HF- Effects of n-3 PUFA and Rosuvastatin on Mortality-Morbidity of Patients With Symptomatic CHF
Investigational drug: rosuvastatin
Document: [The QDF-HF (Quality of life, Depression and Cognitive Functioning in Heart Failure). The project and study protocol] (journal, published 2004-07-01, source pmid:15553328)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
[The QDF-HF (Quality of life, Depression and Cognitive Functioning in Heart Failure). The project and study protocol]

The QDF (Quality of life, Depression Cognitive Function) is a project by nursing personnel, as companion study of the GISSI-HF (Gruppo Italiano per lo Studio della Sopravvivenza nell'Infarto miocardico- Heart Failure). The study aims at describing the evolution of the QDF variables in the patients randomised for the GISSI-HF; at evaluating the reliability of the assessments with standardised instruments (Kansas City Quality of life Questionnaire (KCQQ); Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS) and Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE) compared to the clinical judgement of the nurses; and at describing whether and how the assessment of QDF variables influences decision making and care for these patients (i.e. drug therapies, psychosocial interventions etc). The QDF data are collected at baseline and at 6 months and at 1, 2 and 3 years. The greatest majority of patients are expected to comply with the self administered questionnaires (KCQQ and QDF) while the MMSE will be proposed, via a didactical presentation, only to patients older than 70 years. A specific goal of the project focuses on the degree of independence between the results of the questionnaire and the judgement of nurses. Expected outcomes: epidemiology and distribution of QDF variables among patients of different age-groups and disease severity; description of the prevalence and incidence of severe problems. Up to 2000 patients are expected to be included in this prospective protocol which has already been activated in a network of more then 70 centres.
--- END ---
